in_sanskrit.name: अविराज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: विराजता (avirāja) - the one who is beyond (avir) sorrow, grief, or suffering.

in_hindi.name: अविराज
in_hindi.long_meaning: अविराज (avirāja) - अविर्द्ध (avirddh) राजा, विराजता (avirāja) - the one who is beyond (avir) sorrow, grief, or suffering.

in_tamil.name: அவிராஜ
in_tamil.long_meaning: அவிரக்கம் (avirakam) - அவிர் (avir) + ரக்கம் (rakam) - the one who is beyond (avir) sorrow, grief, or suffering.

in_telugu.name: అవిరాజ
in_telugu.long_meaning: అవిరజ్జ (avirajja) - అవిర్ (avir) + జ్జ (jja) - the one who is beyond (avir) sorrow, grief, or suffering.

in_marathi.name: Aviraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One not bound
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aviraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is not subject to worldly desires and is free from the cycle of birth and death.

in_bengali.name: Aviraj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ One not bound
in_bengali.long_meaning: Aviraj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is not subject to worldly desires and is free from the cycle of birth and death.
